findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall()
select call, "Call to eval or exec."
findings.hypothesis: The package might use eval or exec which can be dangerous if arguments are user-controlled.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Taint source of eval in cli.py
 * @description Tracing where the argument to eval in tqdm/cli.py comes from
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/tqdm-cli-eval-source
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode evalCall, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  evalCall = API::builtin("eval").getACall() and
  evalCall.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "cli.py" and
  arg = evalCall.getArg(0)
select evalCall, "eval call with argument from " + arg.toString()
findings.hypothesis: The eval call in cli.py processes untrusted input from command line arguments.

message.text: eval call with argument from ControlFlowNode for Fstring
